proposed_widenings.name: passive_modifier (class feature family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Extra Attack is a permanent, always-on modification to the Attack action. It has no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three of those fields. There is no honest way to fit a passive permanent buff into the activation family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

proposed_widenings.name: scale_attack_count
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 taxonomy already names this atom ('The number of attacks per Attack action grows with level. Example: Extra Attack (2 → 4)'), but the surface ClassFeatureMechanics type has no family that can emit it. Once a passive_modifier family exists, scale_attack_count is the correct effect atom to use here.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

notes: Extra Attack (Ranger L5) is mechanically identical to Fighter Extra Attack L5, Paladin Extra Attack L5, and Monk Extra Attack L5 — all are passive always-on modifiers, not activated features. Using grant_extra_action would be dishonest: Action Surge grants an additional full action (chosen per turn); Extra Attack permanently changes the Attack action to yield N attacks. The v4 taxonomy has the right atom (scale_attack_count) but the surface type has no class feature family to carry a passive permanent modifier. No content files were authored.
